title: Design and pricing of a transparent parametric-modeled loss CAT bond: application to German windstorm
abstract: arXiv:2609.22052v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Catastrophe (cat) bonds overcome some lack of reinsurance by sourcing capacity from the wider capital markets. We present a new type of cat bond addressing the known trade-off between moral hazard and basis risk. As our main contributions we propose a trigger mechanism which is entirely transparent and simpler to evaluate compared to indemnity modeling techniques, as well as a methodology to price this cat bond. This is relevant for insurers and public authorities in a world where natural disasters are occurring with increasing frequency and severity due to climate change, but also for players willing to enter the cat bond market for whom the lack of transparency of this asset class has been a significant obstacle. Our trigger is derived from a cost random field which separates the physical hazard, a vulnerability function and the exposure. This allows the trigger to take a flexible form between parametric and modeled loss, in case expos

translated_title: 透明参数化-模型化损失巨灾债券的设计与定价：以德国风暴为例
translated_abstract: 巨灾债券通过从更广泛的资本市场获取承保能力，弥补了再保险的某些不足。我们提出了一种新型巨灾债券，以解决道德风险与基差风险之间已知的权衡问题。我们的主要贡献包括：提出了一种完全透明且相较于赔偿建模技术更易于评估的触发机制，以及为该巨灾债券定价的方法论。在气候变化导致自然灾害发生频率和严重程度不断上升的当今世界，这对保险公司和公共机构具有重要意义，同时也对希望进入巨灾债券市场的参与者具有价值，因为该资产类别的透明度缺失一直是进入市场的一大障碍。我们的触发机制源自一个成本随机场，该随机场将物理灾害、脆弱性函数和风险暴露三者分离开来。这使得触发机制能够在参数化损失与模型化损失之间采取灵活的形式，以便在风险暴露（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于成本随机场的透明触发机制和相应定价方法，设计出新型参数化-模型化损失巨灾债券，有效缓解了道德风险与基差风险之间的权衡，并以德国风暴为应用实例。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a new type of CAT bond with an entirely transparent trigger derived from a cost random field separating physical hazard, vulnerability and exposure, together with a pricing methodology, addressing the trade-off between moral hazard and basis risk, applied to German windstorm.
